title: TractionCurrentPersistenceCharacterizationResults
description: Empirical characterization test results from 10 controlled E-Stop shutdown trials on AGV-RES-TRUCK-01 powertrain testbed evaluating PWM ripple, zero-crossing behavior, and current decay persistence.

dataset_metadata.instrumentation: Keysight DSOX1204G DSO + Tektronix TCP303/TCPA300 Current Probe on Phase U

failure_modes_characterization_summary.pwm_current_ripple: During active motor drive at 10 kHz PWM, peak-to-peak ripple was 0.18 A to 0.32 A. Upon E-Stop gate-off, PWM switching pulses ceased within 1.2 ms, collapsing ripple to < 0.03 A.
failure_modes_characterization_summary.ac_zero_crossing_immunity: During active rotation at 10 Hz to 90 Hz, phase current crossed 0.0 A twice per electrical cycle. Instantaneous zero crossings had zero-crossing rate of up to 180 crossings/sec. The 2.0 ms sliding RMS integration window maintained RMS > 2.8 A during active drive, completely eliminating false safe-state detection during normal rotation.
failure_modes_characterization_summary.sensor_noise_floor: Residual quiescent noise floor of TCP303 and laboratory environment was measured at 0.068 A RMS (mean) with peak excursion 0.095 A. All values reside well below the guarded limit of 0.413 A RMS.
failure_modes_characterization_summary.dc_offset_drift: Thermal drift of Hall sensor zero offset over 15 to 48 deg C was +/- 0.022 A, fully captured within the uncertainty budget.
failure_modes_characterization_summary.stator_decay_time_constant: Stator inductive energy freewheeling decay had effective tau_decay = 2.8 ms (faster than theoretical L/R = 4.9 ms due to inverter snubber and active freewheel clamping). 99% current collapse achieved within 6.2 ms after gate-off.
failure_modes_characterization_summary.persistence_window_verification: A persistence window of T_persist = 10.0 ms reliably filtered all freewheeling inductive ringing and zero-crossing artifacts across all 10 trials with zero false triggers and zero rebound excursions.
